## Notes

Bullfrog Productions, Peter Molyneux and Demis Hassabis, EA, MS-DOS June 1994, many ports incl. DS and iOS. Per-visitor personalities, ingredient tuning, research funding, staff, wage and supply negotiations, thugs, yearly judging against rivals, sell park and buy plots worldwide.
